first_input = input().strip()
tokens = first_input.split()
total_segments = int(tokens[0])
available_coins = int(tokens[1])
segment_values = input().strip().split()

odd_segments = 0
even_segments = 0
total_cuts_made = 0
difference_list = []

for i in range(total_segments - 1):
    current_value = int(segment_values[i])
    if current_value % 2 == 0:
        even_segments += 1
    else:
        odd_segments += 1
    if odd_segments == even_segments:
        next_value = int(segment_values[i + 1])
        diff = abs(next_value - current_value)
        difference_list.append(diff)

difference_list.sort()

for difference in difference_list:
    if difference <= available_coins:
        available_coins -= difference
        total_cuts_made += 1
    else:
        break

print(total_cuts_made)
